# SOP-P2-L1-02 Product changeover - Hot Forge line

Revision: Rev C  
Plant: P2, line P2-L1  
Equipment: EQ-P2-L1-RR01, EQ-P2-L1-IH02, EQ-P2-L1-SB03  
Related documents: ECN-2026-023, MM-P2-L1-RR01, SOP-P2-L1-05

Purpose
1. Define the controlled steps to perform a product changeover on the Hot Forge line to ensure metallurgical consistency, equipment integrity, and traceable records.

Scope
2. Applies to operators, lead technicians, and maintenance personnel responsible for EQ-P2-L1-RR01, EQ-P2-L1-IH02, and EQ-P2-L1-SB03 during production changeover activities.

Preconditions
3. Verify that ECN-2026-023 has been released and that the change order scope and affected tooling are identified.  
4. Confirm that MM-P2-L1-RR01 preventive maintenance status for EQ-P2-L1-RR01 is current and that no outstanding critical maintenance actions are open against EQ-P2-L1-RR01, EQ-P2-L1-IH02, or EQ-P2-L1-SB03.  
5. Ensure SOP-P2-L1-05 is available for reference for downstream cooling and quench adjustments.  
6. Obtain written approval for the planned changeover from production supervision before initiating physical work.

Personal protective equipment (PPE)
7. Mandatory PPE for all personnel in the hot area: heat-resistant gloves, face shield, flame-resistant jacket, and safety footwear. Specific items are listed on the local PPE board and must be worn at all times while any part of the process is live. Operators assigned to EQ-P2-L1-IH02 must add hearing protection when the induction heater is active.

Safety and isolation
8. Lockout/tagout is required prior to mechanical adjustments on EQ-P2-L1-RR01 and EQ-P2-L1-SB03. Follow site LOTO procedure. Confirm energy isolation on display at the local control panel. Do not perform mechanical interventions while EQ-P2-L1-IH02 is in induction mode.

Key process targets and constraints
9. The target billet temperature for Hot Forge induction billet heater #2 (EQ-P2-L1-IH02) is 1180 °C. Maintain records showing that billet temperature measurements during the first production run meet the target specified in the job traveller.  
10. The coil cooling water flow minimum for Hot Forge induction billet heater #2 (EQ-P2-L1-IH02) is 55 L/min. Do not operate EQ-P2-L1-IH02 if measured coil cooling water flow is below this value; stop the induction cycle and notify maintenance.

Procedure
11. Preparation
    11.1. Review the incoming job traveller and ECN-2026-023 to confirm tooling changes, billet material, and final part requirements.  
    11.2. Inspect EQ-P2-L1-RR01 and EQ-P2-L1-SB03 for visible damage, correct tooling seating, and free movement. Check that MM-P2-L1-RR01 indicates no active holds.  
    11.3. Confirm condition and connections for EQ-P2-L1-IH02 cooling and power systems; visually inspect coil and cooling lines for leaks or damage.

12. Set-up
    12.1. Load the new tooling into EQ-P2-L1-RR01 per the tooling schematic attached to ECN-2026-023. Ensure fasteners are secured and alignment marks match.  
    12.2. Configure feed and transfer orientation to match new billet geometry; verify grippers and guides at EQ-P2-L1-SB03 seat correctly.  
    12.3. Start the induction billet heating system only after verifying coil cooling water flow meets the coil cooling water flow minimum for Hot Forge induction billet heater #2 (EQ-P2-L1-IH02) is 55 L/min and power interlocks are satisfied.

13. First heat and verification
    13.1. Heat a verification billet and record the measured billet temperature at the exit of EQ-P2-L1-IH02 to confirm the target billet temperature for Hot Forge induction billet heater #2 (EQ-P2-L1-IH02) is 1180 °C. If measurement deviates, do not proceed to full production; follow troubleshooting below.  
    13.2. Run the verification billet through EQ-P2-L1-RR01 and EQ-P2-L1-SB03, inspect forged geometry and flash. Adjust press stroke or trim die per ECN-2026-023 instructions if geometry is out of tolerance.

14. Troubleshooting examples and rationale
    14.1. If measured billet temperature is below target: confirm coil cooling water flow is above the coil cooling water flow minimum for Hot Forge induction billet heater #2 (EQ-P2-L1-IH02) is 55 L/min and check for poor electrical connection to the induction coil. The rationale: coil cooling and electrical continuity directly affect heating efficiency.  
    14.2. If surface oxidation or scale is excessive post-forge: verify billet cleaning step and handling per SOP-P2-L1-05 prior to heating. Proper pre-heat handling reduces furnace atmosphere effects and improves finish.

15. Production release
    15.1. Once verification billet meets target temperature and forged part geometry meets ECN-2026-023 acceptance, obtain production sign-off from the area lead.  
    15.2. Record start of production in the changeover log and attach measurement records for billet temperature, coil cooling water flow, and visual part inspections.

Records to keep
16. Maintain the following records in the job folder:
    16.1. Changeover checklist signed by responsible operator and lead.  
    16.2. Verification billet temperature readouts showing the target billet temperature for Hot Forge induction billet heater #2 (EQ-P2-L1-IH02) is 1180 °C.  
    16.3. Coil cooling water flow measurement data showing the coil cooling water flow minimum for Hot Forge induction billet heater #2 (EQ-P2-L1-IH02) is 55 L/min or greater.  
    16.4. Visual inspection notes and any adjustments performed per ECN-2026-023.  
    16.5. Reference to MM-P2-L1-RR01 maintenance status and any corrective actions taken.

Sign-off
17. Signatures required:
    17.1. Operator performing changeover – name and signature.  
    17.2. Area lead verifying first-piece compliance – name and signature.  
    17.3. Maintenance representative confirming cooling flow and LOTO clearance when applicable – name and signature.  
    17.4. Production supervisor releasing line to run – name and signature.

Appendix
18. Related procedural references for follow-up and ongoing checks: ECN-2026-023, MM-P2-L1-RR01, SOP-P2-L1-05.
